skeleton_rule.name: punctuation skeleton (bleediff.control.parse_skeleton / skeleton_problems)
matched: number of words from the prefix to the header colon, inclusive of the colon word
for the text after the header: the ordered list of complete clauses, each as (word count, terminator) where the terminator is a '.' or ',' that is the LAST character of a whitespace-delimited word
word count and kind ('main' after a period, 'tail' after a comma) of the truncated final clause
total word count and, separately, total UTF-8 byte count
not_matched: punctuation inside a word: hyphens (SEC-21, month-end), decimal points (6.2), colons inside clock times (02:06), thousands separators
letter case, acronyms and upper-case letters
digit count and numeral shape (a numeral such as 41,000 or 5xx counts only as a word of some byte and token length)
the identity or number of numerals
skeleton_rule.consequence: A control can satisfy every frozen criterion and still differ from its treatment in character-class composition (more upper-case, hyphens, decimals and digits in treatments). This residual difference is real and is not removed by this protocol.

preregistered_limitations.text: The neutral control is travel-themed (trail diary, paths, hiker, signpost, winding). That vocabulary lies near the routing and transport domain of the question, and 'trail' is a string prefix of 'trailer' in the treatment. A control displacement in this scenario may reflect topical proximity, not generic sensitivity to appended text.

The neutral control contains 'red flags', a common idiom for warning signs, which may prime warning or severity connotations in a severity-triage task. A control displacement here may reflect that connotation.

Technical-versus-ordinary-prose differences remain between every treatment and its control (acronyms, upper-case, hyphenated compounds, decimals, digit-heavy forms), beyond the frozen matching criteria. See skeleton_rule.

One neutral control per scenario cannot establish content-specific attribution: a single control confounds 'any displaced text of this shape' with 'this particular wording'. Attribution of a treatment residual to the evidence content would need several independently generated controls, which this protocol does not have.
